description: This source file implements the AampMediaStream class and related configuration management classes for media streaming. It manages the media player instance, handles configuration, DRM setup, event notifications, and media control functions like load, stop, seek, and rate adjustment. It also initializes and runs a GMainLoop for media processing.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Abstract class providing configuration and DRM settings application framework, including type-specific extraction methods, and storage of available setting lambdas.

classes.name: DRMSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing DRM-specific configuration settings, including license server URLs and preferred DRM system.

classes.name: ConfigurationSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing general media configuration settings, including bitrate, timeouts, proxy, and other playback parameters.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::Load
methods.description: Loads media from the specified URL and optionally auto-plays.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::SetRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate of the media stream.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::SeekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in seconds.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::InitConfig
methods.description: Initializes media playback with a JSON configuration string, applying general settings including language preferences.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::InitDRMConfig
methods.description: Initializes DRM settings using a JSON configuration string.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for media events.

methods.name: AampMediaStream::SendEvent
methods.description: Sends a media event notification to the registered callback.
